entities.name: Rabiah
entities.description: Collection of one thousand and one originally identical desert planes refracted in the Thousandfold Refraction; setting of Arabian Nights.

entities.name: Thousandfold Refraction
entities.description: Event that refracted the original Rabiah into 1001 planes.

entities.name: Dark Rabiah
entities.description: Version of Rabiah taken over by sinister forces, as evil as Phyrexia.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane often linked to Rabiah, especially Jamuraa.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Evil plane to which Dark Rabiah is compared.

entities.name: Nailah
entities.description: Sorceress Queen whose keep stands at the former Castle of El-Hajjâj.

entities.name: Apprentice Taysir
entities.description: Killed Shepherd Taysir at Nailah's command and later dueled Nailah in the Karun Desert.

entities.name: Shepherd Taysir
entities.description: Seer killed in Fa'adiyah by the Apprentice Taysir.

entities.name: City of Brass
entities.description: City in the far reaches of Rabiah that reflects sunlight, burning visitors.

entities.name: Serendib
entities.description: Island populated by Djinn and Efreeti.

entities.name: Karun Desert
entities.description: Desert where Nailah and the Apprentice found the Nomad and dueled.

entities.name: Allah
entities.description: Only known deity worshiped on Rabiah.

events.summary: The Thousandfold Refraction refracts the original Rabiah into a thousand and one planes.
events.quote: all refracted off of the original Rabiah during the Thousandfold Refraction

events.summary: The Apprentice Taysir kills the Shepherd Taysir in Fa'adiyah at Nailah's command.
events.quote: who was killed there by the Apprentice Taysir at the Sorceress Queen Nailah 's command
